articles.summary:
High above the Arctic, powerful winds usually circle the North Pole each winter, helping trap some of the coldest air on Earth.
 
Strong westerly winds form in the stratosphere, roughly 10 to 30 miles (15-50km) above Earth's surface, locking the coldest air near the pole.
 
Atmospheric disturbances can cause the air high up to start warming which then makes the vortex winds weaken. This sudden stratospheric warming (SSW) can eventually lead to the strong westerlies reversing into easterly winds.
 
So what do you need to know about it? BBC lead weather presenter Simon King answers some of the top questions.

articles.readingText:
High above the Arctic, powerful winds usually circle the North Pole each winter, helping trap some of the coldest air on Earth.

Strong westerly winds form in the stratosphere, roughly 10 to 30 miles (15-50km) above Earth's surface, locking the coldest air near the pole.

Atmospheric disturbances can cause the air high up to start warming which then makes the vortex winds weaken.

This sudden stratospheric warming (SSW) can eventually lead to the strong westerlies reversing into easterly winds.

So what do you need to know about it?

BBC lead weather presenter Simon King answers some of the top questions.

articles.readingTextZh:
在北极上空，强风通常每年冬天环绕北极，帮助捕获地球上最冷的空气。

在地球表面以上约10至30英里（ 15-50公里）的平流层中形成强烈的西风，将极点附近最冷的空气锁定。

大气扰动可能导致高空空气开始变暖，从而使涡旋风减弱。

这种突然的平流层变暖（ SSW ）最终可能导致强大的西风带逆转为东风。

那么，您需要了解哪些信息？

BBC首席气象主持人Simon King回答了一些热门问题。

articles.title: AO3 and the hidden fragility of the internet | Top Comment Podcast
articles.titleZh: AO3和隐藏的互联网脆弱性|热门评论播客
articles.summary:
When the internet’s biggest fanfiction site disappears, there’s one thing you can still count on: a network of fans. 

AO3 hosts more than 18 million works, including many sexually explicit stories, and writing inspired by popular IP, such as Harry Potter, Twilight and Heated Rivalry. 

And the fans have been sharing “fics” on drives to keep each other going while their online haven is down. The non-profit behind AO3, announced the site would be offline for two to four weeks, citing a “security incident”. 

In this episode, Marianna and Matt discuss why people are panicking and whether after other cyber security threats recently - including PHP - the internet is becoming more fragile.

Plus - Marianna has done an experiment to test how AI chatbots might be influencing how people vote and how it could mean for future elections.

00:00 Introduction

00:36 PART ONE: AO3 and fears of the internet apocalypse

13:14 PART TWO: Elections in the age of AI Chatbots

articles.readingText:
When the internet’s biggest fanfiction site disappears, there’s one thing you can still count on: a network of fans.

AO3 hosts more than 18 million works, including many sexually explicit stories, and writing inspired by popular IP, such as Harry Potter, Twilight and Heated Rivalry.

And the fans have been sharing “fics” on drives to keep each other going while their online haven is down.

The non-profit behind AO3, announced the site would be offline for two to four weeks, citing a “security incident”.

In this episode, Marianna and Matt discuss why people are panicking and whether after other cyber security threats recently - including PHP - the internet is becoming more fragile.

Plus - Marianna has done an experiment to test how AI chatbots might be influencing how people vote and how it could mean for future elections.
articles.readingTextZh:
当互联网上最大的粉丝小说网站消失时，您仍然可以依靠一件事：粉丝网络。

AO3拥有超过1800万部作品，包括许多色情故事，以及受《哈利·波特》、《暮光之城》和《激烈竞争》等流行IP启发的作品。

粉丝们一直在驱动器上分享“fics” ，以便在他们的在线避风港关闭时保持彼此的活力。

AO3背后的非营利组织宣布，该网站将离线两到四周，理由是“安全事件”。

在这一集中， Marianna和Matt讨论了人们为什么恐慌，以及在最近出现其他网络安全威胁（包括PHP ）之后，互联网是否变得更加脆弱。

此外， Marianna还进行了一项实验，测试人工智能聊天机器人如何影响人们的投票方式，以及它对未来选举的意义。

articles.title: This Trump loyalist attended dozens of Trump rallies, then defected to Dems
articles.titleZh: 这位特朗普忠实拥护者参加了数十次特朗普集会，然后叛逃到民主党
articles.summary:
Rick Frazier attended dozens of Trump rallies, among the so-called "Front Row Joes." But the Ohio resident voted for Democrats for governor and senator in the midterm elections. Frazier spoke with CNN's Pamela Brown to explain his disillusionment with President Trump.

Also, CNN Senior Correspondent Donie O'Sullivan reports on the MAGA blame game, Tucker Carlson's pronouncement of the end of the Trump era and other fallout from the blue wave in the midterm elections.

0:00 Former Trump supporter and "Front Row Joe" rally attendee Rick Frazier voted for Democrats
3:57 Why Frazier still likes JD Vance
5:55 Frazier: "Seems like politicians are allowed to lie where the average guy isn't."
7:12 MAGA blame game over GOP wipeout begins
9:14 Tucker Carlson: "This is the end of the Trump era...we're done."

Get live election results, analysis & more updates: https://cnn.it/48x1hqU

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#Trump #Election #News
